name: hibbertopterus_trackway
description: The 6 m Hibbertopterus trackway (Fife), top view running left to right on transparent ground (sits on sand #c9a87a or rock #b08f62): two parallel bands of crescent footprints with small satellite prints (darker sand #8a6f4a, light raised rims), offset left/right like a walking gait, and a continuous wavy dragged-tail groove down the middle. No outline frame. Anchor centre, ~1300x200 (x -650..650, y -110..110); the band between the rows stays clear enough for Doug lying inside it.
